pattern: vdot = C.' * F_b(:) / m + g_e(:) - 2 * cross(we, v) - cross(we, cross(we, r));
replacement: vdot = C.' * F_b(:) / m + g_e(:) + 2 * cross(we, v) - cross(we, cross(we, r));
rationale: A Coriolis sign error in the ECEF equations: invisible for a body at rest in ECEF, but the Eotvos lift and the westward drift of the northward cannonball reverse.

replacement: g_e = vital.geo.gravitation(r, Kg) - cross([0; 0; omega], cross([0; 0; omega], r));
rationale: Using GRAVITY (gravitation plus centrifugal) in a rotating-frame EOM double-counts the centrifugal term, ~0.034 m/s^2 at the Equator (CONVENTIONS 4), and reports the wrong localGravity.
'Wind from the west' read as a wind blowing toward the west: the sphere is pushed the wrong way and its aero side force changes sign.

A DAVE-ML maxValue ignored (treated as documentation, not a saturation) on the stick total: the longitudinal stick exceeds +1 and the elevator exceeds its 25 deg authority (ADR-014). The first test (saturationsAreApplied) drove only the LOWER limit and missed it; everyLimitIsObservableAndApplied drives every limit on both sides.
The +/-180 deg course-error wrap dropped: across north the autopilot would command a 358 deg turn the long way round.
A signal no reference simulation records is silently reported as passing instead of NOT_ASSESSABLE (a quiet skip dressed as evidence).
A VITAL run stopped early by a guard would be compared only over the part it flew and could pass.
The aileron stick-total lower limit ignored: the aileron command exceeds -21.5 deg authority in a large left-roll demand.
The pedal-total upper limit ignored: the rudder command exceeds its 30 deg authority.
The throttle-total lower limit ignored: a negative power-lever command below idle is passed to the thrust model.
The pilot longitudinal-stick input limit ignored: an out-of-range pilot input is added unclamped to the trim and LQR terms (observable only when the LQR term offsets it).
The autopilot 30 deg bank-command limit ignored: the course loop would command more than the 30 deg bank the NESC reference flies (phi = 30.00 deg in cases 13.3, 13.4, 15, 16).
An F-16 case flown from a trim that did not converge or is infeasible (stall-limited) is simulated anyway instead of being refused: every downstream comparison would then be meaningless.
The GNC variant (F16_gnc.dml, used by cases 15 and 16) has its own copy of every limit; the throttle-total upper limit ignored there lets a power-lever command above 100 % reach the thrust model.
